entries.en: to gather more and more; to keep adding
entries.notes: 词头 may y may 按 17 世纪拼法读作 más y más（推断展开），R 栏空缺，据 H『却添』与西语 recojer 语义定释义

entries.en: to take (someone) in and provide for them; to shelter and feed
entries.notes: 西语 al perfido（『奸恶之人』）与 H『带、饲』对应未安，释义取 recojer『收留』义与 H 栏『带回收养』

entries.en: to tidy up; to gather and put in order
to clear away; to remove, put away
entries.notes: H『收除』第二字与 L『componer』（整理/收好）对应不齐，据『收』义取清除、收起
西语词头 lo fiera de probes 拼写缺损难读（疑含 pobres『穷人』），H『处使』语义不明，R 栏空缺，无法定夺

entries.en: to reconcile (a friendship); to make up
to make peace again; to become reconciled with someone
to become reconciled; to settle/conclude (a peace)
entries.notes: H、M 栏空缺，R 栏 Hoc jīm 转写不明，据西语词头 reconciliarse 定『和解』义

entries.en: to concede another's superiority; to yield
entries.notes: H 字判读存疑（[疑:默/煞]），据 M『qieng』与下条『敬服』取『敬/服输』义

entries.en: to respect and submit to (a superior); to admire and defer
to acknowledge a kindness; to give thanks for a favor
entries.notes: M 栏转写与汉字不对应，R 栏 cham cay tory & siān ley 杂乱，据 L 与 H『慚愧』（自谦承情）定『领情道谢』义

entries.en: to acknowledge oneself beaten; to concede defeat
entries.notes: H『犯伊跤』字义不明，R 栏空缺，据西语 reconocerse por vencido 定『认输』义

entries.en: to lean on, rest upon (supported from below)
entries.notes: R 栏 tog te 后一音节不明，据 H『托』与上条『倚』取倚托义

entries.en: to lie face down (head resting on one's arms)
entries.notes: 词头拼写缺损，按 boca abajo sobre los braços（面朝下伏于臂上）读；H『头覆在处』与之相应

entries.en: to rely on, lean upon another

entries.notes: R 栏尾段残乱（para iso irg），H『光景』取游赏之景义与西语 recreación（消遣）相配
